item.title: Tsugaru Stove Train: Aomori's Retro Winter Ride — Guide
item.description: The Tsugaru Railway ‘stove train’ is a nostalgic winter ride through the snowy Tsugaru plain. Vintage railcars are warmed by pot-belly coal stoves, and attendants grill dried squid (surume) right on top — you buy one and eat it as the train rattles through white countryside. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Goshogawara, Aomori Hours Runs ~Dec–Mar, several daily Admission Fare + stove-car supplement (~¥500) Time needed About 1 hour each way Best time Winter (Dec–Mar) What to Expect Vintage railcars heated by coal-burning stoves.
